FloPlast gutter guards effectively prevent leaves and debris from blocking PVC guttering, ensuring a non-restrictive flow of rainwater and maintaining optimum drainage system performance. These robust black polypropylene guards are an ideal solution for property maintenance professionals and homeowners seeking to protect guttering. Each 500mm section is suitable for half round 112mm and square 114mm profiles. Installation is straightforward with an easy clip-fit design requiring no screws. Supplied in a convenient 10-pack providing 5 metres of coverage, they are broadly compatible with major brands such as Polypipe, Hepworth, Osma, Hunter, Marley, Brett and Marshall Tufflex.
